title: Optional component charge review
software_contract: review_package(request) validates all input before evaluating alternatives; invalid input raises ValueError (message unspecified). Do not mutate input. All components are optional; any subset including empty is allowed. Its charge is base_cost plus the cost of each selected component plus every adjustment whose two members are both selected. Signed costs represent charges or credits; repeated and reversed adjustments are separate additive entries, never deduplicated. Return component_count, base_cost, current, lowest_cost, avoidable_cost. current contains selected in component input order, component_cost, applied_adjustment_indices in adjustment input order (zero-based), adjustment_cost, total_cost. lowest_cost is the exact least attainable total charge over all subsets. avoidable_cost equals current.total_cost minus lowest_cost; it is nonnegative. Do not return or require a particular attaining subset; ties do not affect the numeric result. Empty catalogues return base_cost. CLI reads one JSON request and prints one report; invalid input has nonzero exit and no successful report.
input_domain: Object with exactly base_cost (Python int, not bool), components, adjustments and current (finite lists). Each component has exactly name (unique nonempty string) and cost (Python int, not bool). Each adjustment has exactly members (two distinct known component-name strings) and cost (Python int, not bool). Repeated/reversed member pairs are allowed. current contains distinct known component names in any order. No numeric or list-length cap is imposed; negative costs are valid. There are no hidden dependencies, required components, spending limits or excluded combinations.
execution_assumptions: Integer catalogue units are abstract charges, not measured runtime or an economic forecast. All stated component combinations are permitted.
No hardware, workload-size distribution, circuit cost, latency target or practical benefit is supplied.
